rules.name: Imported event: encoded or download command line
rules.description: An imported Defender XDR process event has a command line with an encoded PowerShell argument or a download-and-execute pattern.
rules.rationale: Advanced hunting exports include process command lines. The same patterns used for live data are applied to the imported rows.
rules.titleTemplate: Imported event: {FileName} on {DeviceName} has an encoded or download command line
falsePositives: Management tooling that uses encoded PowerShell
rules.recommendedNextStep: Review the full row in Defender XDR, the device timeline and the initiating process.
rules.remediation: Follow your incident response process in Defender XDR. This toolkit never changes the system; any action is a manual decision for an authorized responder after validation.
limitations: Exported data, not a live query; completeness depends on what was exported.

rules.name: Imported alert: High severity
rules.description: An imported Defender XDR alert row has severity High.
rules.rationale: The alert was produced by Defender XDR analytics. This toolkit surfaces it with the rest of the findings; it does not re-evaluate the alert logic.
evidenceRequirements: Imported alert rows with Title and Severity
rules.recommendedNextStep: Open the alert in Defender XDR and review the evidence and the incident it belongs to.
rules.remediation: Follow your incident response process in Defender XDR. This toolkit never changes the system; any action is a manual decision for an authorized responder after validation.
limitations: An alert is not an ATT&CK technique mapping; use the alert's own technique tags in Defender XDR.

rules.name: Imported alert: Medium severity
rules.description: An imported Defender XDR alert row has severity Medium.
rules.rationale: See WTH-XDR-002. Medium alerts are surfaced separately so they can be filtered.
evidenceRequirements: Imported alert rows with Title and Severity
rules.recommendedNextStep: Open the alert in Defender XDR and review the evidence.
rules.remediation: Follow your incident response process in Defender XDR. This toolkit never changes the system; any action is a manual decision for an authorized responder after validation.
limitations: An alert is not an ATT&CK technique mapping.
